Situation Report — Day 27

Active: Ongoing US/Israeli airstrikes on Iran and Iranian/Hezbollah/Hamas missile strikes on Israel.

Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan is mediating. Qatari PM met US envoys; Doha says negotiations continue without high‑level direct talks.

  • International military posture: NATO/Turkey reopened talks on Patriot and SAMP/T missile defenses amid rising ballistic threats. US envoys active in Doha. Limited international port/route access shifted toward friendly states.
  • Security incidents: Arrest reported of a US citizen accused of spying for Iran (Jerusalem). Israeli humanitarian mission dispatched to Venezuela despite frozen relations.
  • Energy / Economy: Iran claims oil exports and price gains after partial lifting of US measures; details politically leveraged.
  • 🟢 Good News: 10-day pause announced could reduce immediate strikes if honored; Pakistan/Qatar mediating — diplomatic channels open.
Threat assessment: Escalating
